snippet.title: Paper Robot - trailer
snippet.description:
Follow the adventures of the recently reactivated robot D4-BB13 (or Dabble for short) as he travels near and far in his quest for the golden gears needed to repair the legendary Dream Machine. Meet a huge cast of colorful characters, and team up with new partners to explore the lands. Collect modules and items to power up Dabble in this classic turn-based, low-number combat system where every point of damage counts!

Paper Robot has been in development since summer 2024. I'm a solo developer handling art, animation, and programming, with a talented musician supplying custom music written specifically for this game. 

The playable demo (all of chapter 1!) is available now! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597430/Paper_Robot/

I'm aiming for a full release of the game sometime in the next few years. Video games take a lot of work!

More information will be available at https://dabbleworks.github.io/ 

Check out live development streams at https://www.twitch.tv/dobbsworks
